items.title: Astaroth Malware Turns Your WhatsApp Account Into a Malware-Spreading Machine

items.title: The Gentlemen Ransomware Kills Nearly 180 Security Processes Before Encrypting Your Files

items.title: PHP Patches Three Flaws Enabling SQL Injection, Memory Corruption and Server Crashes
items.description: PHP has addressed three security vulnerabilities in its latest maintenance releases, including high-severity flaws that can expose applications to SQL injection and out-of-bounds memory writes. These vulnerabilities affect optional PHP extensions commonly used by web applications: ext-pgsql, ext-bcmath, and ext-phar.
